crossRefs.note: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”

people.name: Dothan
people.line: A place where Joseph found his brothers and was sold.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ ” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
translations.bsb: “They have moved on from here,” the man answered. “I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” So Joseph set out after his brothers and found them at Dothan.
translations.kjv: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
translations.asv: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
